title: Group a Beads store into plans; scope the PR view to the plans a PR moved (ADR-0040)
nugit plan normalize — canonical serialization so concurrent agents stop conflicting
nugit plan check — the reader's own tolerances, reported instead of silent
Read a PR body so the store can contradict a claimed close
An export changes only its objective's plans: a merged export from the shared bd database writes only the plan of the branch's objective, and a line no one changed keeps its bytes (ADR-0061)
acceptance_criteria: merging an export unchanged since its base against HEAD reproduces HEAD byte for byte, whatever spelling and derived counts HEAD carries; with an objective, every plan but the objective's is written exactly as HEAD has it and the database edits left there are named; -plans adds plans and -plans all exports every plan; with no objective the export is unscoped and says so in one line

title: The merge base is nugit's to write: what a scoped export leaves out stays pending, and a line that differs only in how it spells dependencies keeps HEAD's bytes (ADR-0064)
acceptance_criteria: after a scoped export, a later export that names another plan still carries the bead filed, the update and the delete the first one left out; a no-base export keeps HEAD's line when the two differ only in dependency order, an empty list, or copies of other beads' edges; an unscoped export's next base is the raw export
